heading: Research equipment grants

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary may make competitive grants for the acquisition of special purpose scientific research equipment for use in the food and agricultural sciences programs of eligible institutions.

tree.heading: Maximum amount
tree.text: The amount of a grant made to an eligible institution under this section may not exceed $500,000.

tree.heading: Prohibition on charge or equipment as indirect costs
tree.text: The cost of acquisition or depreciation of equipment purchased with a grant under this section shall not be—

children.text: charged as an indirect cost against another Federal grant; or
included as part of the indirect cost pool for purposes of calculating the indirect cost rate of an eligible institution.
